shippingVisualReview.scope: Direct visual inspection of all nineteen final Shipping screenshots by root and model reviewer. No blocking issues observed in these captured states.

observations: Dark navy cloud has visibly shaded rounded lobes above the target cluster; warning circle, units and surrounding HUD remain visible.
Rain is fine and subtle at full-frame size; this still does not establish visibility of every individual droplet.
Bright thin white/cyan strike strokes and small status sparkles are visible at the front of the target cluster, including the Ironclad side.
Impact is localized without a blinding full-screen flash; dense health bars partially overlap the weather area.

views.observations: Dark shaded cloud reads above the targets; narrow white/cyan bolts connect its lower lip to target edges. The area ring remains bounded, units and hand are readable, with no blocking UI overlap. Rain and status sparkles remain subtle at arena distance.

observations: Cloud and renewed localized lightning strokes remain visible at the third-wave sample, with damaged targets beneath.
Small status sparkles are visible; their individual star silhouettes are not clearly resolved at this full-frame scale.
Cloud and lightning are absent at the cleanup sample; damaged surviving units and health bars remain.
Arena, hand and control panels remain unobstructed.
Purple Blade Box roof, body and team ring are distinct from the arena; no child is visible yet.
Camera views the rear and roof, so this view cannot directly prove front-door opening clearance.
Purple Twin Blade is visibly emerging beyond the building toward the river; the roof occludes part of the child from this rear camera angle.
Building and child remain clear of the hand and control panels.
Twin Blade has fully separated to the right/front of Blade Box and its body is visible.
Rear-facing camera does not expose front-door panels; exact closure is covered by native pose evidence, not inferred from this image.
All 24 cards are visible in a coherent three-row collection, with readable names, types and cost badges inside their bounds.
Thunderstorm and Blade Box portraits are clear; refined Ember Archer hair/face and Boulderback plates read coherently at thumbnail size.
No obvious portrait hand or weapon overlap is visible at this display scale.
Corrected view shows THREE LIGHTNING STRIKES and no ONE DAMAGE APPLICATION or burst-applies-once paragraph.
Displayed cost 3, 65 troop damage and 33 structure damage per strike, radius 3.00, first impact 0.45 seconds and 3 waves are readable.
Ability text states waves at 0.45, 0.90 and 1.35 seconds, refreshing 0.25-second stun; 195 troop/99 structure total is consistent.
Cloud/lightning portrait, ability explanation and How To Play It text fit their panels.
Front portrait shows door opening, emerging fighter, roof blades and trim clearly.
Cost 5, HP 500, one Twin Blade every 3 seconds and 30-second lifetime are readable; ability explains up to 10 fighters, stun pauses and destruction.
Text fits without clipping in the visible area. Strong Against is empty in this spawner view; no claim that offscreen recommendation entries were reviewed.
Cost 4, five members, 133.2 HP, 24 damage per 0.90 seconds, 26.67 DPS per member, 666 total HP and 133.33 total DPS are readable and consistent.
Movement 3.50, range 1.00 and front/rear sight 8/5 remain readable; split-deployment guidance fits.
Hog portrait and visible ability panels show no overlap.
Visible Mini Stampede and Stampede sections clearly separate old/new values, numeric delta and percentages.
Mini cost 2 to 4 is +100%; HP 111 to 133.2 and damage 20 to 24 are +20%; displayed DPS/group totals are consistent with rounded formulas.
Mixed and Buff badges are legible; entries below the viewport were not visually reviewed.
Both teams show distinct ground, air and building silhouettes, including Blade Box, Dart Gun, refined Archer and Boulderback.
Deliberately dense fixture causes neighboring models to overlap in projection, while arena and hand/HUD remain clear.
This wide view is not a close facial, grip or animation-clearance inspection.

views.observations: Before activation the Iron Giant bodies remain visible inside bounded purple ground cues. The cast indication is readable without covering the hand or nearby units.

After activation the friendly Iron Giant becomes a recognizable purple masked silhouette; the opposing cloaked body is absent. Public ground effect fades around the cast location. Other troops and battle controls remain readable.
Friendly cloaked Iron Giant remains purple after the cast cue fades. Opposing cloaked body remains absent. Health display for the damaged friendly unit is legible; no added status-word clutter.
Compact model portraits align beside card names in the populated 100-match Meta table. Row height and numeric columns remain consistent, with no thumbnail/text overlap.

Small portraits align on both axes of the populated matchup matrix. Narrow column labels remain bounded, full row names remain readable, and all score cells stay aligned without overlapping the portraits.

reviewLimitations: Still screenshots do not establish animation smoothness or all gameplay states.
Still images do not prove continuous animation smoothness or audio.
Fine rain and status sparkles are small at the full arena scale; individual droplet counts and star shapes are not visually established.
The Blade Box gameplay camera sees the rear and roof, so native imported-pose tests are needed for front-door opening/closing transforms.
Collection and roster scales do not establish close-up hand/grip clearance for every character.
Patch-notes and recommendation entries outside the displayed viewport were not inspected.
shippingVisualReview.limitation: Recorded visual inspection applies to these inspected views; it does not assert every pose or game state is free of defects.

limitations: Numerical checks do not establish universal visual quality or listening acceptance.
